'''Bels Lank''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with his daughter, [[Reen (Tatooinian)|Reen]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on his [[Lank's farm|farm]] around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] who was searching for [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]].<ref name="TM" />
